content.text:
Both section headings on the products page, "All products" and "Bundles", now render in capitals at 16px with 0.08em letter spacing. I added the rule to `site/css/pages.css`, scoped to `.page-products .section-title`, so the matching headings on the other pages are unchanged.

- **Functional tests:** they pass.
- **Visual tests:** the other pages' screenshots still match, but the products page fails at desktop and phone size. I read the desktop diff image: the new heading style shows up, and the content below moves up a little because the headings are smaller. I didn't change the approved screenshots. If the new look is what you want, the products screenshots need re-approving, with `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots`. That will refresh every page's screenshot, not just products.

STATUS: DONE
